text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 16 tests. I didn't touch the tests, only the code in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5. The comment above it and the tests both say five.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days late instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns exactly `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my guess, since the tests only check the title.
